title: Mastery Challenge: Prisms, Cylinders, Pyramids & Frustums

questions.promptText: What is the volume of a frustum of a pyramid having a height of $6\text{ m}$, lower base area $B_1 = 36\text{ m}^2$, and upper base area $B_2 = 16\text{ m}^2$?
Find the length of the space diagonal of a rectangular parallelepiped with dimensions $4\text{ cm} \times 5\text{ cm} \times 12\text{ cm}$.
What is the lateral area of a right circular cylinder of radius $r = 5\text{ cm}$ and altitude $h = 14\text{ cm}$?
questions.explanation:
$A_L = 2\pi r h = 2\pi(5)(14) = 140\pi \approx 439.82\text{ cm}^2$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $2 \times 5 \times 14 \times \pi = 140\pi$.

questions.promptText: An oblique prism has a lateral edge length of $e = 15\text{ cm}$ and a right section area of $K = 24\text{ cm}^2$. What is its volume?
questions.explanation:
$V = K \cdot e = 24 \times 15 = 360\text{ cm}^3$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $24 \times 15 = 360\text{ cm}^3$.

questions.promptText: A truncated prism with triangular base of area $B = 30\text{ cm}^2$ has three vertical edge heights of $4\text{ cm}, 6\text{ cm}$, and $11\text{ cm}$. Find its volume.
questions.explanation:
$V = B \left(\frac{h_1 + h_2 + h_3}{3}\right) = 30 \left(\frac{4 + 6 + 11}{3}\right) = 30 \left(\frac{21}{3}\right) = 30(7) = 210\text{ cm}^3$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $30 \times 7 = 210\text{ cm}^3$.

questions.promptText: A right circular cone has a base radius of $r = 6\text{ cm}$ and height $h = 8\text{ cm}$. What is its total surface area?
questions.explanation:
Slant height $L = \sqrt{6^2 + 8^2} = 10\text{ cm}$. Lateral area $= \pi r L = 60\pi$. Base area $= \pi r^2 = 36\pi$. Total Area $= 60\pi + 36\pi = 96\pi \approx 301.59\text{ cm}^2$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $\pi(6)(10 + 6) = 96\pi$.

questions.promptText: Find the volume of a right circular cone of radius $r = 5\text{ cm}$ and altitude $h = 12\text{ cm}$.
questions.explanation:
$V = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h = \frac{1}{3}\pi(25)(12) = 100\pi \approx 314.159\text{ cm}^3$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $25 \times 4 \times \pi = 100\pi$.

questions.promptText: Find the slant height $L$ of a frustum of a cone with radii $R = 9\text{ cm}, r = 4\text{ cm}$, and height $h = 12\text{ cm}$.
questions.explanation:
$L = \sqrt{h^2 + (R - r)^2} = \sqrt{12^2 + (9 - 4)^2} = \sqrt{144 + 25} = \sqrt{169} = 13\text{ cm}$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: 5-12-13 Pythagorean triple $\implies L = 13\text{ cm}$.

questions.promptText: What is the lateral area of the conical frustum described in Question 8 ($R = 9, r = 4, L = 13$)?
questions.explanation:
$A_L = \pi (R + r) L = \pi (9 + 4)(13) = 169\pi \approx 530.929\text{ cm}^2$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $13 \times 13 \times \pi = 169\pi$.

questions.promptText: Which of the 5 Platonic Solids is geometrically a regular square prism?
questions.explanation: A cube is a regular hexahedron having 6 identical square faces.

questions.promptText: What is the volume of a pyramid with a square base of side $s = 6\text{ m}$ and vertical height $h = 10\text{ m}$?
If the volume of a cube is $512\text{ cm}^3$, what is its total surface area?
questions.explanation:
$a = \sqrt[3]{512} = 8\text{ cm}$. $A_s = 6 a^2 = 6(8^2) = 6(64) = 384\text{ cm}^2$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $6 \times 64 = 384\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.promptText: What is the ratio of the volume of a right circular cone to the volume of a circumscribed cylinder with the same base and height?
questions.explanation: $V_{\text{cone}} = \frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h$ and $V_{\text{cylinder}} = \pi r^2 h$, so the ratio is exactly $1/3$.

questions.promptText: Find the volume of a conical frustum with base radii $R = 6\text{ cm}, r = 3\text{ cm}$ and height $h = 7\text{ cm}$.
questions.explanation:
$V = \frac{\pi h}{3}(R^2 + r^2 + Rr) = \frac{7\pi}{3}(36 + 9 + 18) = \frac{7\pi}{3}(63) = 7\pi(21) = 147\pi \approx 461.814\text{ cm}^3$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $7 \times 21 \times \pi = 147\pi$.

questions.promptText: What defines an "oblique" prism or cylinder compared to a "right" one?
questions.choiceA: The lateral faces or cylindrical generating lines are not perpendicular to the base planes
questions.choiceD: The height is greater than the diameter
questions.explanation: In an oblique solid, the axis/lateral edges are inclined at an angle $\theta \ne 90^\circ$ relative to the base planes.

questions.promptText: A rectangular tank of base $2\text{ m} \times 3\text{ m}$ is filled with water to a depth of $1.5\text{ m}$. What is the total mass of the water (density $= 1000\text{ kg/m}^3$)?
questions.explanation: $V = 2 \times 3 \times 1.5 = 9\text{ m}^3$. Mass $= 9 \times 1000 = 9000\text{ kg}$.

questions.promptText: If the height of a right circular cone is doubled while keeping the base radius constant, by what factor does its volume increase?
questions.explanation: $V \propto h$, so doubling $h$ doubles the volume (factor of 2).

questions.promptText: If the radius of the base of a cone is doubled while height remains constant, by what factor does its volume increase?
questions.explanation: $V \propto r^2$, so doubling $r$ scales the volume by $2^2 = 4$.

questions.promptText: An excavation trench with a rectangular base of area $B = 50\text{ m}^2$ has 4 corner depths of $2\text{ m}, 3\text{ m}, 4\text{ m}, 7\text{ m}$. What is the total earthwork volume to be excavated?
questions.explanation:
$h_{\text{avg}} = (2 + 3 + 4 + 7)/4 = 16/4 = 4\text{ m}$. $V = 50 \times 4 = 200\text{ m}^3$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $50 \times 4 = 200\text{ m}^3$.

questions.promptText: What is the total surface area of a cube with space diagonal $d = 6\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}$?
questions.explanation:
$d = a\sqrt{3} \implies a = 6\text{ cm}$. $A_s = 6 a^2 = 6(36) = 216\text{ cm}^2$.

⚡ Speed Shortcut: $6 \times 36 = 216\text{ cm}^2$.

questions.promptText: A bucket in the shape of a conical frustum has top radius $R = 14\text{ cm}$, bottom radius $r = 7\text{ cm}$, and depth $h = 24\text{ cm}$. What is its capacity in liters?
What is the cross-section of an oblique cylinder made by a plane perpendicular to its lateral generating line called?
questions.explanation: A right section ($K$) is by definition the cross-section perpendicular to the lateral edges of a prism or cylinder.
